exposure: persistent low back and pelvic pain (LBPP) after delivery
outcome: Persistent low back and pelvic pain (LBPP)
cohort: 330 women at 4 months after delivery who had LBPP during pregnancy
finding: Women with a GWG of ≥15 kg had a higher prevalence of persistent LBPP compared to those with a GWG of <10 kg.
mod_finding: The study controlled for mode of delivery as a confounding factor but did not investigate its relationship with the primary outcome (persistent low back and pelvic pain).
